sentences: The loop goes through and swaps when the next number is smaller, so all numbers end up in order.
After checking pairs from start to end, the smallest keeps moving left until everything is sorted.
Each comparison fixes the order, so by the last pair the whole array becomes sorted.
Swapping bigger with smaller as j goes up puts every number in its correct place.
The passes rearrange all the values, so after the loop finishes the array is fully ordered.
